english: The ISS digipeater answers to the path {{path}}. A pass shifts the frequency a few kHz (Doppler); Nexus corrects it while the ISS is overhead.
italian: Il digipeater della ISS risponde al path {{path}}. Un passaggio sposta la frequenza di qualche kHz (Doppler); Nexus la corregge mentre la ISS è sopra di te.
Correggi lo spostamento Doppler della ISS

english: While the ISS is overhead, Nexus keeps the radio on the corrected frequency: the receive frequency between packets, and the transmit frequency for each packet it sends. It never retunes while transmitting. Off, the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz.
italian: Mentre la ISS è sopra di te, Nexus tiene la radio sulla frequenza corretta: quella di ricezione tra un pacchetto e l'altro, e quella di trasmissione per ogni pacchetto inviato. Non risintonizza mai durante la trasmissione. Disattivata, la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz.

english: Doppler corrected: listening on {{rx}} MHz, sending on {{tx}} MHz.
italian: Doppler corretto: ascolto su {{rx}} MHz, trasmissione su {{tx}} MHz.

english: Doppler correction is off. The radio stays on {{freq}} MHz.
italian: La correzione Doppler è disattivata. La radio resta su {{freq}} MHz.

english: The ISS is below the horizon, so the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz.
italian: La ISS è sotto l'orizzonte, quindi la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz.

english: Nexus has no orbital elements for the ISS, so the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz. Refresh them under Satellites.
italian: Nexus non ha elementi orbitali per la ISS, quindi la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz. Aggiornali in Satelliti.

english: The ISS orbital elements are too old to tune by, so the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz. Refresh them under Satellites.
italian: Gli elementi orbitali della ISS sono troppo vecchi per sintonizzare, quindi la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz. Aggiornali in Satelliti.

english: Set your grid square in Settings to correct the Doppler shift. Until then the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz.
italian: Imposta il tuo locatore in Impostazioni per correggere lo spostamento Doppler. Fino ad allora la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz.

english: Doppler correction needs CAT control of the radio. Without it the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz.
italian: La correzione Doppler richiede il controllo CAT della radio. Senza, la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz.

english: The Satellites tracker is steering the radio for a pass, so this correction stands aside.
italian: Il tracker Satelliti sta pilotando la radio per un passaggio, quindi questa correzione si fa da parte.

english: The radio was tuned off the ISS channel, so the Doppler correction has stopped and Nexus will not move the radio back. Pick the ISS channel again to restart it.
italian: La radio è stata sintonizzata fuori dal canale ISS, quindi la correzione Doppler si è fermata e Nexus non riporterà indietro la radio. Riseleziona il canale ISS per riavviarla.

english: This radio did not hold the corrected frequency it was sent (it rounds to its own tuning step), so the Doppler correction is off for this pass and the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz.
italian: Questa radio non ha mantenuto la frequenza corretta che le è stata inviata (arrotonda al proprio passo di sintonia), quindi la correzione Doppler è disattivata per questo passaggio e la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz.

english: The Doppler correction stopped working, so the radio stays on {{freq}} MHz. Restart Nexus to bring it back.
italian: La correzione Doppler ha smesso di funzionare, quindi la radio resta su {{freq}} MHz. Riavvia Nexus per ripristinarla.

english: Repeating CQ is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to let the CQs go out.
italian: La ripetizione del CQ è attiva, ma il TX è spento: nulla va in trasmissione. Attiva il TX (la pillola nell'intestazione) per far partire i CQ.

english: Calling CQ every {{min}} min, on your TX offset. Stops on its own when a station answers you, or at the idle watchdog. Click to stop the schedule — a CQ already on the air finishes; Stop TX cuts it.
italian: Chiamata CQ ogni {{min}} min sul tuo offset TX. Si ferma da sola quando una stazione ti risponde o al watchdog di inattività. Clic per fermare la programmazione: un CQ già in aria termina; Stop TX lo interrompe.
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).

english: Repeating CQ is on, but no CQ is scheduled: the interval was 0 when the last one went. Turn it off and on to call again.
italian: La ripetizione del CQ è attiva, ma nessun CQ è programmato: l'intervallo era 0 quando è partito l'ultimo. Disattivala e riattivala per chiamare di nuovo.

english: Heartbeat schedule is off. Click to send a heartbeat every period’s interval (Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8) — it keys only while TX is on, and it is never remembered across launches.
italian: La programmazione degli heartbeat è disattivata. Clic per inviare un heartbeat a ogni intervallo (Impostazioni ▸ Digitale ▸ JS8): trasmette solo con il TX attivo e non viene mai ricordata tra un avvio e l'altro.

english: Heartbeat schedule is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to let heartbeats go out.
italian: La programmazione degli heartbeat è attiva, ma il TX è spento: nulla va in trasmissione. Attiva il TX (la pillola nell'intestazione) per far partire gli heartbeat.

english: Heartbeats are going out on schedule, on a random free slot between 500 and 1000 Hz. Click to stop the schedule.
italian: Gli heartbeat partono come programmato, su uno slot libero casuale tra 500 e 1000 Hz. Clic per fermare la programmazione.

english: HB is on, but no heartbeat of yours is scheduled: with the interval at 0 (Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8), HB sends one when it is turned on, and that one has gone. Turn HB off and on, or use Send heartbeat now on its menu, for another.
italian: HB è attivo, ma nessun tuo heartbeat è programmato: con l'intervallo a 0 (Impostazioni ▸ Digitale ▸ JS8), HB ne invia uno quando lo attivi, e quello è già partito. Disattiva e riattiva HB, oppure usa Invia heartbeat ora dal suo menu, per inviarne un altro.

english: The heartbeat repeat is paused while a call is in the To box (the QSO pause, Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8). Clear the To box and it starts again, its first heartbeat one interval later.
italian: La ripetizione dell'heartbeat è in pausa mentre c'è un nominativo nella casella A (la pausa QSO, Impostazioni ▸ Digitale ▸ JS8). Svuota la casella A e riparte, con il primo heartbeat un intervallo dopo.
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 dock’s HB button while the heartbeat repeat is paused because a call is in the To box, the dock’s addressee field. HB is the heartbeat button.

notes: Tooltip on the HB NET chip, JS8Call’s heartbeat networking switch. HB NET stays as it is.

english: Heartbeat networking is on: HB sends your heartbeats, and HB ACK may answer the heartbeats you hear. Click to turn it off (remembered); a running heartbeat repeat stops.
italian: La rete heartbeat è attiva: HB invia i tuoi heartbeat e HB ACK può rispondere agli heartbeat che ricevi. Clic per disattivarla (viene ricordato); una ripetizione di heartbeat in corso si ferma.

english: No heartbeats at {{speed}}: JS8Call sends heartbeats and their acknowledgements only at Slow, Normal and Fast. HB is hidden until you change speed, and this switch keeps its setting.
italian: Nessun heartbeat a {{speed}}: JS8Call invia heartbeat e relative conferme solo a Slow, Normal e Fast. HB resta nascosto finché non cambi velocità, e questo interruttore mantiene la sua impostazione.
notes: {{speed}} is a JS8 speed name (Turbo). Slow, Normal and Fast are JS8 speed names and stay as they are.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but none goes out at {{speed}}: JS8Call answers heartbeats only at Slow, Normal and Fast.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma a {{speed}} non ne parte nessuna: JS8Call risponde agli heartbeat solo a Slow, Normal e Fast.
notes: {{speed}} is a JS8 speed name (Turbo).

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but held back now: a message is still arriving, as in JS8Call.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma ora sono trattenute: un messaggio sta ancora arrivando, come in JS8Call.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but held back now: a call is in the To box (the QSO pause, Settings ▸ Digital ▸ JS8). Clear the To box to answer heartbeats again.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma ora sono trattenute: c'è un nominativo nella casella A (la pausa QSO, Impostazioni ▸ Digitale ▸ JS8). Svuota la casella A per rispondere di nuovo agli heartbeat.
notes: The To box is the JS8 dock’s addressee field.

english: Not answering these stations, which heartbeat more often than every 55 minutes: {{calls}}.
italian: Nessuna risposta a queste stazioni, che inviano heartbeat più spesso di ogni 55 minuti: {{calls}}.
notes: {{calls}} is a list of callsigns.
Plural form "one" — this key has one row per form (::one = exactly 1, ::other = every other count, 0 included). Fill both rows separately; never merge them into one sentence.
Plural form "other" — this key has one row per form (::one = exactly 1, ::other = every other count, 0 included). Fill both rows separately; never merge them into one sentence.

english: ≈ {{count}} frame — over the {{max}}-frame airtime cap; shorten it
italian: ≈ {{count}} frame — oltre il limite di {{max}} frame di tempo in aria; accorcialo
notes: Plural form "one" — this key has one row per form (::one = exactly 1, ::other = every other count, 0 included). Fill both rows separately; never merge them into one sentence.

english: ≈ {{count}} frames — over the {{max}}-frame airtime cap; shorten it
italian: ≈ {{count}} frame — oltre il limite di {{max}} frame di tempo in aria; accorcialo
notes: Plural form "other" — this key has one row per form (::one = exactly 1, ::other = every other count, 0 included). Fill both rows separately; never merge them into one sentence.

english: How many periods this takes on the air (one frame per period). An estimate — the engine packs the real frames and refuses anything over ten minutes of airtime.
italian: Quanti periodi occupa in aria (un frame per periodo). È una stima: il motore impacchetta i frame reali e rifiuta tutto ciò che supera dieci minuti di tempo in aria.

english: Auto-reply is off — an answer to SNR?, GRID?, INFO? or STATUS? to you, an ACK for a MSG or a relay is put in the message box for you to send, as JS8Call does, and nothing keys by itself; QUERY MSGS goes unanswered. Click to turn it on (remembered). It answers only while TX is on.
italian: La risposta automatica è disattivata: una risposta a SNR?, GRID?, INFO? o STATUS? rivolti a te, un ACK per un MSG o un relay vengono messi nella casella del messaggio perché sia tu a inviarli, come fa JS8Call, e nulla va in trasmissione da solo; QUERY MSGS resta senza risposta. Clic per attivarla (viene ricordato). Risponde solo con il TX attivo.
do_not_translate: SNR? | GRID? | INFO? | STATUS? | ACK | MSG | QUERY MSGS | JS8Call | TX
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 cockpit's AUTOREPLY chip while it is off. The capitalised words are JS8 command words and are not translated. The message box is the JS8 cockpit's text field where you type a message (js8.dock.compose.aria).

english: Auto-reply is on, but TX is off — nothing keys; a reply is shown as “would have replied”. Enable TX (the header pill) to let replies go out.
italian: La risposta automatica è attiva, ma il TX è spento: nulla va in trasmissione; una risposta appare come «avrebbe risposto». Attiva il TX (la pillola nell'intestazione) per far partire le risposte.

english: Auto-reply is ARMED: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, QUERY and MSG addressed to you or a group you joined are answered, each after your Yes when Settings asks for one. Click to turn it off.
italian: La risposta automatica è ARMATA: SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, QUERY e MSG indirizzati a te o a un gruppo a cui sei iscritto ricevono risposta, ognuno dopo il tuo Sì quando le Impostazioni lo richiedono. Clic per disattivarla.
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 cockpit's AUTOREPLY chip while it is on and TX is on: the automatic replies will really go out. SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, QUERY and MSG are JS8 command words and are not translated.

english: Relay is off — a > message routed through you is displayed and not passed on. Click to turn it on (remembered). Relaying is third-party traffic; you are responsible for it.
italian: Il relay è disattivato: un messaggio > instradato tramite te viene mostrato e non inoltrato. Clic per attivarlo (viene ricordato). Il relay è traffico per conto terzi; ne sei responsabile.

english: Relay is on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill) to relay.
italian: Il relay è attivo, ma il TX è spento: nulla va in trasmissione. Attiva il TX (la pillola nell'intestazione) per fare relay.

english: Relay is ARMED: a > message routed through you is retransmitted with *DE* your call, and the final hop is acknowledged. With Auto-reply off, it is put in the message box for you to send instead. Click to turn it off.
italian: Il relay è ARMATO: un messaggio > instradato tramite te viene ritrasmesso con *DE* e il tuo nominativo, e l'ultimo salto viene confermato. Con la risposta automatica spenta, viene invece messo nella casella del messaggio perché sia tu a inviarlo. Clic per disattivarlo.
notes: Tooltip on the JS8 cockpit's RELAY chip while it is on and TX is on. > is how a JS8 message is routed through another station; *DE* is a JS8 word and is not translated. Auto-reply is the AUTOREPLY chip.

english: Relay is on, but with AUTOREPLY off a relay is put in the message box for you to send, and nothing keys by itself. Turn AUTOREPLY on to relay on the air.
italian: Il relay è attivo, ma con AUTOREPLY spento un relay viene messo nella casella del messaggio perché sia tu a inviarlo, e nulla va in trasmissione da solo. Attiva AUTOREPLY per fare relay in aria.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are off (JS8Call’s default). Click to answer heartbeats with HEARTBEAT SNR (remembered). Answers only while TX is on.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono disattivate (predefinito di JS8Call). Clic per rispondere agli heartbeat con HEARTBEAT SNR (viene ricordato). Risponde solo con il TX attivo.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but TX is off — nothing keys. Enable TX (the header pill).
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma il TX è spento: nulla va in trasmissione. Attiva il TX (la pillola nell'intestazione).

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are ARMED: each heartbeat heard is answered with HEARTBEAT SNR on a random free slot. Click to turn it off.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono ARMATE: a ogni heartbeat ricevuto si risponde con HEARTBEAT SNR su uno slot libero casuale. Clic per disattivarle.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while heartbeat networking (HB NET) is on, as in JS8Call. HB NET sends nothing by itself.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma rispondono solo con la rete heartbeat (HB NET) attiva, come in JS8Call. HB NET da solo non trasmette nulla.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while AUTOREPLY is on, as in JS8Call. Turn AUTOREPLY on.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma rispondono solo con AUTOREPLY attivo, come in JS8Call. Attiva AUTOREPLY.

english: Heartbeat acknowledgements are on, but they answer only while heartbeat networking (HB NET) and AUTOREPLY are both on, as in JS8Call. HB NET sends nothing by itself.
italian: Le conferme di heartbeat sono attive, ma rispondono solo con la rete heartbeat (HB NET) e AUTOREPLY entrambi attivi, come in JS8Call. HB NET da solo non trasmette nulla.

english: Two acts, where JS8Call has one: this switch is the second, the header’s TX pill is the first, and the chip reads ARMED only while both are on.
italian: Due azioni, dove JS8Call ne ha una: questo interruttore è la seconda, la pillola TX nell'intestazione è la prima, e il chip indica ARMATO solo quando sono attive entrambe.

english: Not armed: nothing from you for {{min}} min, so the idle watchdog holds it. Your next send, switch, speed choice, or Read or Delete in the Inbox brings it back.
italian: Non armato: nessuna tua attività da {{min}} min, quindi il watchdog di inattività lo trattiene. Il tuo prossimo invio, interruttore, scelta di velocità, oppure Leggi o Elimina nella Posta lo riattiva.

english: Would reply to {{to}} — TX is off, nothing keys: {{text}}
italian: Risponderebbe a {{to}} — il TX è spento, nulla va in trasmissione: {{text}}

english: JS8 idle watchdog: no operator activity for {{min}} min — HB, AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK and the repeating CQ are off. TX stays as you left it. Your next send, switch, speed choice, or Read or Delete in the Inbox brings back AUTOREPLY, RELAY and HB ACK as Settings has them; HB and the repeating CQ stay off until you switch them on.
italian: Watchdog di inattività JS8: nessuna attività dell'operatore da {{min}} min — HB, AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK e il CQ ripetuto sono spenti. Il TX resta come l'hai lasciato. Il tuo prossimo invio, interruttore, scelta di velocità, oppure Leggi o Elimina nella Posta riattiva AUTOREPLY, RELAY e HB ACK come impostati; HB e il CQ ripetuto restano spenti finché non li riattivi.
do_not_translate: JS8 | {{min}} | HB | AUTOREPLY | RELAY | HB ACK | CQ | TX
notes: The notice when the JS8 idle watchdog trips. HB, AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK and CQ are the labels on the dock's switches and are not translated. Read and Delete are the two buttons on a message in the JS8 Inbox; Settings is the Settings screen.

english: A transmission is queued for autoreply: {{text}} — would you like to send this transmission?
italian: Una trasmissione è in coda come risposta automatica: {{text}} — vuoi inviare questa trasmissione?
notes: In the JS8 cockpit's dock, when an automatic reply waits for your answer: JS8Call's own question (its Autoreply Confirmation box). {{text}} is the reply exactly as it will be sent, for example KD9TAW: W1AW SNR -07.

The button that answers js8.dock.confirm: send the automatic reply. The same English text "Yes" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. qso.detail.qsl.yes, js8.pill.cmd.yes) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Send it: it goes out in the next period, through every TX check.
italian: Inviala: parte al periodo successivo, passando ogni controllo TX.
notes: Tooltip on the Yes button of the automatic-reply question in the JS8 cockpit. TX is not translated.
The button that answers js8.dock.confirm: do not send it. {{secs}} counts down the seconds until it answers No by itself, as JS8Call's box does.

english: Do not send it. With no answer it is No when the count reaches 0, as in JS8Call.
italian: Non inviarla. Senza risposta, diventa No quando il conteggio arriva a 0, come in JS8Call.
notes: Tooltip on the No button of the automatic-reply question.

english: Queued frames — one leaves per period while TX is on. F/L mark the first and last frame of a message.
italian: Frame in coda: ne parte uno per periodo con il TX attivo. F/L segnano il primo e l'ultimo frame di un messaggio.

english: Drop every queued frame. Not a stop: a frame already on the air finishes — Stop TX cuts it.
italian: Elimina ogni frame in coda. Non è uno stop: un frame già in aria termina; Stop TX lo interrompe.
notes: "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README).

One-word control on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Italian word. The same English text "you" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. qso.history.source.operator) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Where a queued frame came from: a JS8 heartbeat, the automatic "I am here" frame (JS8Call's HEARTBEAT).
Where a queued frame came from: the answer to another station's heartbeat (sent as HEARTBEAT SNR).
One-word control on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Italian word.
One-word control on: JS8 cockpit — the message dock. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Italian word.
Where a queued frame came from: an APRS message from the internet, relayed over JS8 to a station heard on the air.

english: Idle watchdog tripped — your next send or switch brings back AUTOREPLY, RELAY and HB ACK; HB and the repeating CQ stay off until you switch them on
italian: Watchdog di inattività scattato: il tuo prossimo invio o interruttore riattiva AUTOREPLY, RELAY e HB ACK; HB e il CQ ripetuto restano spenti finché non li riattivi
do_not_translate: AUTOREPLY | RELAY | HB ACK | HB | CQ
notes: The line in the JS8 cockpit's dock while the idle watchdog has tripped. AUTOREPLY, RELAY, HB ACK, HB and CQ are the labels on the dock's switches and are not translated; the repeating CQ is the CQ button set to call again and again.

english: Set your callsign in Settings before transmitting
italian: Imposta il tuo nominativo in Impostazioni prima di trasmettere
notes: The same English text "Set your callsign in Settings before transmitting" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. rtty.send.noCallsign, psk.send.noCallsign) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A short notice after “Save current message” in the JS8 dock’s Saved menu. {{text}} is the saved message.

english: The message could not be saved
notes: A short notice after “Save current message” in the JS8 dock’s Saved menu. {{text}} is the saved message.

english: TX locked — this frequency is outside your license privileges
italian: TX bloccato — questa frequenza è fuori dai privilegi della tua licenza
notes: The same English text "TX locked — this frequency is outside your license privileges" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. rtty.send.txLocked, psk.send.txLocked, cw.send.txLocked) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: A command needs a station — put a callsign, @ALLCALL or a group in To
italian: Un comando richiede una stazione: metti un nominativo, @ALLCALL o un gruppo in A

notes: A short error notice: your Yes or No to an automatic reply did not reach the station (or that reply was no longer waiting).

english: What JS8Call shows in its RX pane: the traffic on your RX offset and what is addressed to you or your groups, each message on one line as its frames arrive, the end mark after its last frame and the missing-frame mark where one did not come. Every frame of every offset is in Band activity.
italian: Ciò che JS8Call mostra nel suo riquadro RX: il traffico sul tuo offset RX e ciò che è indirizzato a te o ai tuoi gruppi, ogni messaggio su una riga man mano che arrivano i frame, il segno di fine dopo l'ultimo frame e il segno di frame mancante dove uno non è arrivato. Ogni frame di ogni offset è in Attività di banda.

english: Listening… what is sent on your RX offset, and what is addressed to you, prints here
italian: In ascolto… qui compare ciò che viene inviato sul tuo offset RX e ciò che è indirizzato a te

notes: Tooltip on a line of the JS8 RX pane that opens with a callsign. {{call}} is that callsign; a double-click puts it in the To box.

english: One row per frequency offset in the passband, holding the frames heard there with the end mark after each message: its age, SNR, time delta and speed come from the newest. Read it to find a clear offset and to see who is in sync. Columns and order are in ⋯.
italian: Una riga per ogni offset di frequenza nella banda passante, con i frame ricevuti lì e il segno di fine dopo ogni messaggio: età, SNR, delta di tempo e velocità vengono dal più recente. Usala per trovare un offset libero e vedere chi è in sincronia. Colonne e ordinamento sono in ⋯.

notes: Column heading in the JS8 Band activity table: the text heard at that offset (one or several messages).
Accessible name of the ⋯ button that opens one Band activity row’s menu. {{offset}} is the audio offset in Hz.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: the audio offset of a signal, in Hz. The same English text "Offset" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. memories.grid.column.offset, memories.editor.offset.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: how long ago a station or offset was last heard. The same English text "Age" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. spots.column.age, operate.roster.col.age, aprs.table.age) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: the signal report in dB. The same English text "SNR" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. connect.getout.sort.snr, js8.view.col.snr) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: how far a station is off the period clock, in milliseconds. The same English text "Time delta" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.tdrift) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 lists: the JS8 speed (Slow, Normal, Fast, Turbo) a station sends at. The same English text "Speed" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.submode, cw.wpm.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Accessible name of the JS8 call list’s first column, which holds one symbol per station (✕ ⚑ ★ ☎ ⚟).

Column heading in the JS8 call list, with the number of stations listed. Plural form "one" — this key has one row per form (::one = exactly 1, ::other = every other count, 0 included). Fill both rows separately; never merge them into one sentence.

Column heading in the JS8 call list, with the number of stations listed. Plural form "other" — this key has one row per form (::one = exactly 1, ::other = every other count, 0 included). Fill both rows separately; never merge them into one sentence.

Column heading in the JS8 call list: the Maidenhead grid square. The same English text "Grid" is used by 11 different keys (e.g. settings.station.grid.label, logEntry.grid.placeholder, logEntry.fd.grid.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 call list. The same English text "Distance" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. connect.getout.sort.distance, js8.view.col.distance, contestStats.distance.head) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 call list: the operator’s name from your log. The same English text "Name" is used by 10 different keys (e.g. logEntry.name.placeholder, logbook.field.name.label, logbook.filters.name) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Column heading in the JS8 call list: the comment from your log. The same English text "Comment" is used by 7 different keys (e.g. logPrompt.comment.label, logbook.field.comment.label, spots.column.comment) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Accessible name of the call list column with the one-click query buttons (SNR?, GRID?, INFO?, HEARING?, QUERY MSGS).
Accessible name of the column of ⋯ buttons, one per row, that open each row’s menu.
Accessible name of the ⋯ button that opens one station’s menu in the JS8 call list. {{call}} is its callsign.

english: Blocked: messages from this station are hidden in the RX pane (Settings ▸ JS8)
italian: Bloccato: i messaggi di questa stazione sono nascosti nel riquadro RX (Impostazioni ▸ JS8)

notes: Tooltip on ★ in the JS8 call list: the station sent something to your callsign, so it hears you. {{since}} is how long ago, e.g. 4m.
Tooltip on ☎ in the JS8 call list: the station called CQ. {{since}} is how long ago, e.g. 2m.
Tooltip on ⚟ in the JS8 call list: the station was named in a message relayed to you. {{through}} is the relaying station’s callsign.

english: Unread message for {{group}}, in the Inbox
italian: Messaggio non letto per {{group}}, nella Posta
notes: Tooltip on ⚑ beside a @GROUP in the JS8 call list. {{group}} is the group, e.g. @FUN. Inbox is the JS8 pane that lists messages.

italian: Aggiungi una stazione o un gruppo
Nominativo della stazione o del gruppo
notes: Field label in the JS8 dialog that adds a station (a callsign) or joins a group (a name starting with @).

The same English text "Add" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. watchlist.add.submit, settings.js8.freqs.add.action, settings.js8.saved.add) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Cancel" is used by 32 different keys (e.g. logEntry.sent.moved.cancel, logbook.import.preview.cancel, logbook.parkStates.cancel) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: {{name}} is not a valid callsign or group
italian: {{name}} non è un nominativo o un gruppo valido
notes: Error under the field when the text is neither a callsign nor a @GROUP. {{name}} is what was typed.
Error under the field when a name starting with @ is not a valid group. {{name}} is what was typed.
Accessible name of a JS8 pane’s ⋯ button, which opens its view options. {{pane}} is the pane’s name.
Submenu in a JS8 list’s ⋯ menu, listing the orders the list can take.
Submenu in a JS8 list’s ⋯ menu, listing the columns that can be shown.

italian: Mostra heartbeat e ACK della banda
notes: A switch in the Band activity ⋯ menu that shows or hides heartbeat frames and their acknowledgements.
The same English text "Frequency offset" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.offset) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Callsign" is used by 8 different keys (e.g. settings.station.callsign.label, gettingStarted.station.shot.callsignLabel, setup.station.callsign.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A sort order of the JS8 call list: the stations that sent something to you, most recent first.
The same English text "Azimuth" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.col.azimuth) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Frequency offset" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.sort.offset) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "SNR" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. connect.getout.sort.snr, js8.col.snr) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Time delta" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.col.tdrift) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Speed" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. js8.col.speed, cw.wpm.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Callsign" is used by 8 different keys (e.g. settings.station.callsign.label, gettingStarted.station.shot.callsignLabel, setup.station.callsign.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Grid" is used by 11 different keys (e.g. settings.station.grid.label, logEntry.grid.placeholder, logEntry.fd.grid.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same English text "Distance" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. connect.getout.sort.distance, js8.calls.col.distance, contestStats.distance.head) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
The same English text "Azimuth" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.view.sort.azimuth) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

A column name in the call list’s Show columns menu: the ✓ for a station already in your log. The same English text "Worked before" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. operate.decodes.filter.title.b4) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Menu entry that empties one JS8 list (the RX pane, Band activity or the call list). The same English text "Clear" is used by 17 different keys (e.g. logEntry.clear.label, logbook.search.clear, logbook.tools.bulk.clear) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The RX pane, Band activity and the call list start empty and fill again as stations are heard, and the compose box is emptied, as in JS8Call. Your Inbox, your settings and the station’s own record of who it heard are kept.
italian: Il riquadro RX, Attività di banda e l'elenco nominativi ripartono vuoti e si riempiono di nuovo man mano che si ricevono stazioni, e la casella di composizione viene svuotata, come in JS8Call. La tua Posta, le tue impostazioni e il registro della stazione di chi ha ricevuto vengono mantenuti.

notes: Menu entry: move your receive and transmit audio offsets to this one. {{offset}} is in Hz.
Menu entry: switch your JS8 transmit speed to this station’s. {{speed}} is a speed name (Slow, Normal, Fast, Turbo).
Menu entry on a Band activity row: take that offset’s row off the list until it is heard again.
Menu entry on a call list row: keep that station at the top of the list.
Menu entry on a pinned call list row: let it go back into the list’s order.

english: The JS8 list was not saved
italian: L'elenco JS8 non è stato salvato

notes: Button on the new-message notice that opens the Inbox at that station’s messages. The same English text "Show" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. program.filters.show.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Accessible name of the Inbox’s row of controls (station filter, Reply, Delete). The same English text "Inbox" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. js8.panel.inbox) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

Informazioni su Tune con questa radio

english: {{plate}} needs CAT control — this radio is set up for VOX or serial PTT only. Add rig control in Settings ▸ Radio to get it.

english: {{plate}} is picked from the pads this radio publishes, and it has not published any — Nexus will not command one it might not have. Reconnect rig control in Settings ▸ Radio to ask again.

english: No rig control on this radio — the receiver and transmitter controls need CAT. Settings ▸ Radio.

italian: Guadagno RF del ricevitore secondario — il suo stadio d'ingresso. Impostato da Nexus; la radio non lo riporta.

english: AF gain of the sub receiver — how loud it plays. Set from Nexus; the radio does not report it back.
italian: Guadagno AF del ricevitore secondario — quanto forte suona. Impostato da Nexus; la radio non lo riporta.

italian: Nexus non ha potuto impostare {{plate}} del ricevitore secondario.

italian: Nexus non ha potuto impostare il livello del monitor.

italian: Catena di ricezione — cosa stai ascoltando

italian: L'attenuazione d'ingresso, in decibel — l'attenuatore che questa radio rende disponibile. Usalo quando un vicino forte fa pompare l'AGC; ti costa anche i segnali deboli.

notes: One-word control on: Phone (SSB) cockpit. Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Italian word.

english: The receive preamp, by the name this radio gives each position — on some rigs they are numbered rather than decibels. Worth it on a quiet band; on a noisy one it lifts the noise with the signal.
italian: Il preamplificatore di ricezione, con il nome che questa radio dà a ogni posizione — su alcune radio sono numerate invece che in decibel. Utile su una banda tranquilla; su una rumorosa alza il rumore insieme al segnale.

english: How loud the radio plays your own voice back while you are transmitting. It is heard only on transmit, so turning it down can never silence a decoder — that is AF.
italian: Quanto forte la radio ti fa riascoltare la tua voce mentre trasmetti. Si sente solo in trasmissione, quindi abbassarlo non può mai silenziare un decodificatore — quello è l'AF.

english: Transmit contract — what goes out when you key
italian: Riepilogo di trasmissione — cosa esce quando trasmetti

english: The frequency your next over will actually be emitted on — the engine’s own answer, with any confirmed split and any XIT offset already in it. Under split this is NOT your receive dial.
italian: La frequenza su cui verrà effettivamente emessa la tua prossima trasmissione — la risposta del motore stesso, con già incluso lo split confermato e l'eventuale scostamento XIT. In split NON è la tua frequenza di ricezione.

english: Nexus worked this frequency out from what it commanded and cannot confirm all of it against the radio — either there is no CAT link, or XIT is in play and the clarifier is write-only, so an offset dialled at the radio would not show here.
italian: Nexus ha ricavato questa frequenza da ciò che ha comandato e non può confermarla del tutto con la radio — o manca il collegamento CAT, oppure è in uso lo XIT e il clarifier è in sola scrittura, quindi uno scostamento impostato sulla radio non comparirebbe qui.

english: This station is not reporting a transmit frequency. Nexus will not print your receive dial in its place — under split they are unrelated numbers.
italian: Questa stazione non riporta una frequenza di trasmissione. Nexus non mostrerà al suo posto la tua frequenza di ricezione — in split sono numeri non correlati.

english: Nexus cannot state your transmit frequency on FM through a repeater — the shift is applied by the radio and is not in the frequency the engine reports, so printing one here would be your listening frequency wearing a transmit label. Check the shift in Settings ▸ Radio, or read it off the radio.
italian: Nexus non può indicare la tua frequenza di trasmissione in FM tramite un ripetitore — lo shift è applicato dalla radio e non è nella frequenza riportata dal motore, quindi mostrarne una qui sarebbe la tua frequenza di ascolto con un'etichetta di trasmissione. Controlla lo shift in Impostazioni ▸ Radio o leggilo sulla radio.

english: The mode your next over goes out in, and where Nexus got it. This is the same read-back the logbook writes, so what you see here and what gets recorded cannot disagree.
italian: Il modo in cui esce la tua prossima trasmissione e da dove Nexus l'ha preso. È la stessa rilettura che scrive il log, quindi ciò che vedi qui e ciò che viene registrato non possono essere diversi.

english: How far your transmit frequency sits from your receive dial (kHz)
italian: Quanto dista la tua frequenza di trasmissione dalla tua frequenza di ricezione (kHz)

english: Nexus asked the radio for this split. The snapshot does not carry the radio’s own confirmation, so it is shown as commanded rather than read back — check the radio if the pile-up is not hearing you where you expect.
italian: Nexus ha chiesto questo split alla radio. Lo stato non include la conferma della radio, quindi viene mostrato come comandato e non come riletto — controlla la radio se il pile-up non ti sente dove ti aspetti.

english: Transmit incremental tuning — the offset added to your transmit frequency (Hz)
italian: Sintonia incrementale di trasmissione — lo scostamento aggiunto alla tua frequenza di trasmissione (Hz)

english: Nexus cannot read XIT back from any radio, so this is what Nexus commanded — not necessarily where the transmitter is. An offset set on the radio’s own clarifier knob will not appear here.
italian: Nexus non può rileggere lo XIT da nessuna radio, quindi questo è ciò che Nexus ha comandato — non necessariamente dove si trova il trasmettitore. Uno scostamento impostato con la manopola del clarifier della radio non comparirà qui.

english: Your power setting, and the output the radio last actually measured. No mark: the setting is the radio’s read-back when CAT reports one and the last commanded value otherwise, and nothing says which.
italian: La tua impostazione di potenza e l'uscita misurata per ultima dalla radio. Senza segno: l'impostazione è la rilettura della radio quando il CAT la riporta e altrimenti l'ultimo valore comandato, e nulla indica quale delle due.

english: VOX is on — the radio keys itself from the mic. Stop TX cannot unkey a VOX-held transmitter.
italian: Il VOX è attivo — la radio va in trasmissione da sola dal microfono. Stop TX non può sbloccare un trasmettitore tenuto dal VOX.

italian: Guadagno AF — il volume della radio. italian: Nexus nello shack decide chi può trasmettere. Approvazione e abbinamento avvengono lì e da nessun'altra parte.

italian: Eliminare l'account rimuove l'account, le tue stazioni con i loro dispositivi e gli inviti fatti lì, e i tuoi dispositivi presso le stazioni di altri. Vengono tutti disconnessi subito e le persone che hai invitato perdono l'accesso. Nexus nello shack continua a funzionare.

english: We keep only what stops a second free trial (fingerprints of your address, callsign and shack computer, and your trial dates) and the billing records the law requires.
italian: Conserviamo solo ciò che impedisce una seconda prova gratuita (impronte del tuo indirizzo, del nominativo e del computer dello shack, e le date della prova) e i dati di fatturazione richiesti dalla legge.

english: Deleting your account cancels your subscription at once: access ends now and the unused part of the period is not refunded. If you are within 14 days of your first payment, ask for your refund before you delete.
italian: Eliminare l'account annulla subito l'abbonamento: l'accesso termina ora e la parte non usata del periodo non viene rimborsata. Se sei entro 14 giorni dal primo pagamento, chiedi il rimborso prima di eliminarlo.

english: Your subscription could not be cancelled, so nothing was deleted. Try again in a few minutes.
italian: Non è stato possibile annullare l'abbonamento, quindi non è stato eliminato nulla. Riprova tra qualche minuto.

english: This account already has two stations. Revoke one you are not using before pairing another.
italian: Questo account ha già due stazioni. Revoca quella che non usi prima di abbinarne un'altra.

english: That pairing code has expired or has already been used. Get a fresh one from Nexus at the shack.
italian: Quel codice di abbinamento è scaduto o è già stato usato. Ottienine uno nuovo da Nexus nello shack.

english: A pairing code is sixteen characters, digits 0-9 and letters a-f only. Check for a letter O where a zero should be.
italian: Un codice di abbinamento ha sedici caratteri, solo cifre 0-9 e lettere a-f. Controlla di non aver scritto una lettera O al posto di uno zero.

english: This station already has as many approved browsers as it allows. Forget one you no longer use, then try again.
italian: Questa stazione ha già il numero massimo di browser approvati. Dimenticane uno che non usi più, poi riprova.

english: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again to carry on.
italian: Il tuo accesso è scaduto. Accedi di nuovo per continuare.

english: Sign-in was refused. If you have just created an account, confirm your email with the code or link we sent, then sign in again.
italian: Accesso rifiutato. Se hai appena creato un account, conferma l'email con il codice o il link che ti abbiamo inviato, poi accedi di nuovo.

english: Your sign-up worked, but the email address is not confirmed yet. Enter the six-digit code we emailed you on the sign-up screen, or if you received a link, click it. Then come back here and continue. If you land back on this page, the email is not confirmed yet.
italian: La registrazione è riuscita, ma l'indirizzo email non è ancora confermato. Inserisci nella schermata di registrazione il codice a sei cifre che ti abbiamo inviato, oppure, se hai ricevuto un link, cliccalo. Poi torna qui e continua. Se torni a questa pagina, l'email non è ancora confermata.

english: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam or junk folder for an email from Nexus Remote. A code works for fifteen minutes, and a link for five days.
italian: Non arriva nulla dopo qualche minuto? Controlla nella cartella spam o posta indesiderata un'email da Nexus Remote. Un codice vale quindici minuti, un link cinque giorni.
notes: "Nexus Remote" is the name the email arrives from, so it stays as it is.

english: This email address already has a Remote trial running under a different sign-in, such as Google instead of a password. Sign out, then sign in the way you did the first time.
italian: Questo indirizzo email ha già una prova di Remote attiva con un altro metodo di accesso, ad esempio Google invece di una password. Esci, poi accedi come la prima volta.

english: Too many tries. Wait up to ten minutes, then try again.
italian: Troppi tentativi. Attendi fino a dieci minuti, poi riprova.

english: That station is not reachable. Check that Nexus is running at the shack, that Remote is on there (Settings → Remote), and that the computer is awake and online.
italian: Quella stazione non è raggiungibile. Verifica che Nexus sia in esecuzione nello shack, che lì Remote sia attivo (Impostazioni → Remote) e che il computer sia acceso e online.

english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your trial and your stations below.
italian: L'accesso remoto a questa stazione è terminato, quindi questo browser è stato disconnesso. Controlla la tua prova e le tue stazioni qui sotto.

english: Remote access to this station ended, so this browser was disconnected. Check your stations below.
italian: L'accesso remoto a questa stazione è terminato, quindi questo browser è stato disconnesso. Controlla le tue stazioni qui sotto.

english: Each station approves its browsers separately, so this browser needs approving for this station too.
italian: Ogni stazione approva i propri browser separatamente, quindi questo browser va approvato anche per questa stazione.

english: Signing out keeps this browser approved. On a shared computer, press “Remove this browser’s approval” for each station before you sign out.
italian: Uscire mantiene l'approvazione di questo browser. Su un computer condiviso, premi «Rimuovi l'approvazione di questo browser» per ogni stazione prima di uscire.
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Remove this browser’s approval" is the on-screen text of remote.forgetBrowser. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint points at a menu entry that no longer exists.

english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC.
italian: Questo browser è approvato fino al {{until}} UTC.

english: This browser is approved until you remove it in Nexus at the shack.
italian: Questo browser è approvato finché non lo rimuovi in Nexus nello shack.

english: This browser is approved until {{until}} UTC. Using the station from here keeps it approved, up to {{limit}} UTC.
italian: Questo browser è approvato fino al {{until}} UTC. Usare la stazione da qui mantiene l'approvazione, fino al {{limit}} UTC.

english: This browser’s approval ends {{until}} UTC. To keep using it, approve it again in Nexus at the shack.
italian: L'approvazione di questo browser scade il {{until}} UTC. Per continuare a usarlo, approvalo di nuovo in Nexus nello shack.

notes: On the Remote page, under a station. {{key}} is this browser's device key as a short fingerprint, like 3F2A 9C1B 77E0 4D12; Nexus at the shack shows the same one beside the browser, and the operator compares the two.

english: This station’s key has changed: the Remote service now lists a different key for it than the one this browser kept. Nothing connects until you accept the new key. Compare it with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack, and accept it only if they match.
italian: La chiave di questa stazione è cambiata: il servizio Remote ora indica per essa una chiave diversa da quella conservata da questo browser. Non si connette nulla finché non accetti la nuova chiave. Confrontala con «Chiave di questa stazione» in Nexus nello shack e accettala solo se corrispondono.
notes: “This station’s key” is the start of the line where Nexus at the shack shows its key (remote.thisStationKey): use the same words, so the operator can find it there.

english: Revoking access disconnects this station and removes the approval of every browser that used it. To use it again, pair it again at the shack and approve your browsers there again.
italian: Revocare l'accesso disconnette questa stazione e rimuove l'approvazione di ogni browser che l'ha usata. Per usarla di nuovo, abbinala di nuovo nello shack e riapprova lì i tuoi browser.

english: In Nexus at the shack, open Settings → Remote and press “Pair a station”. Enter the code shown there.
italian: In Nexus nello shack, apri Impostazioni → Remote e premi «Abbina una stazione». Inserisci il codice mostrato lì.
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Pair a station" is the on-screen text of remote.pairStation. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.
The same English text "Pairing code" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.code) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: "{{station}}" is linked to your account and waiting for approval in Nexus at the shack. Match the account ID there and approve it. The code is good for about {{minutes}} more minutes.
italian: «{{station}}» è collegata al tuo account e attende l'approvazione in Nexus nello shack. Verifica lì l'ID account e approvala. Il codice è valido ancora per circa {{minutes}} minuti.

english: Pair this station with your Remote account. Approving the pairing turns Remote on and approves the browser you paired from; approve any other browser here. While Remote is on, approved browsers receive your station, contact, radio and amplifier data.
italian: Abbina questa stazione al tuo account Remote. Approvare l'abbinamento attiva Remote e approva il browser da cui hai abbinato; approva qui qualsiasi altro browser. Mentre Remote è attivo, i browser approvati ricevono i dati di stazione, collegamenti, radio e amplificatore.

english: Your current contact draft is unchanged. Start a new contact with {{call}} when ready.
italian: La bozza del collegamento attuale non è cambiata. Inizia un nuovo collegamento con {{call}} quando sei pronto.

english: This is not available from the browser right now. Open it in Nexus at the shack.
italian: Al momento non è disponibile dal browser. Aprilo in Nexus nello shack.

english: Journey, confirmation diagnostics and uploads are not available remotely yet.
italian: Viaggio, diagnostica delle conferme e caricamenti non sono ancora disponibili da remoto.

notes: Short label on: Listen control of the remote browser (the station's receive audio, played in the browser). The same English text "Listen" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. remote.listen.open, remote.account.role.listen) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

One-word control on: Listen control of the remote browser (the station's receive audio, played in the browser). Out of context this could be a noun or a verb — open that screen (or read the key name) before choosing the Italian word. The same English text "Volume" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. settings.thisComputer.audio.volume.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Audio gap - the link is losing packets
italian: Buco nell'audio: il collegamento sta perdendo pacchetti

english: Audio stalled - the link, not the band
italian: Audio bloccato: è il collegamento, non la banda

english: This browser cannot play station audio. Chrome, Edge, Firefox on a computer, or Safari 26 can.
italian: Questo browser non può riprodurre l'audio della stazione. Chrome, Edge, Firefox su computer o Safari 26 possono.

english: The station changed its audio device. Press Listen again.
italian: La stazione ha cambiato dispositivo audio. Premi di nuovo Ascolta.

english: Another browser is listening to this station.
italian: Un altro browser sta ascoltando questa stazione.

english: Audio stopped because station control was lost.
italian: Audio interrotto perché il controllo della stazione è stato perso.

notes: Text on the Stop TX button while the stop command is on its way to the station.
Text on the Stop TX button once the station has accepted the stop command.

english: Copy the file from the station into this computer’s Downloads folder
italian: Copia il file dalla stazione nella cartella Download di questo computer

notes: The same English text "Saved to {{path}}" is used by 4 different keys (e.g. awards.status.saved, awards.custom.exported, sstv.viewer.save.done) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Could not save the station’s file to this computer
italian: Impossibile salvare il file della stazione su questo computer

english: {{name}} is not a recording, an SSTV picture or ALL.TXT
italian: {{name}} non è una registrazione, un'immagine SSTV o ALL.TXT
La stazione non ne ha ancora.

english: Could not list the station’s files
italian: Impossibile elencare i file della stazione

notes: The same English text "Close" is used by 12 different keys (e.g. logbook.import.done.close, logbook.qslCards.close, logbook.form.close) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The station has accepted the Stop. It is not off the air until the station reports the transmitter free.
italian: La stazione ha accettato lo Stop. Non è fuori aria finché la stazione non segnala il trasmettitore libero.
notes: "Stop" here is what the Stop TX button sends: the command that ends a transmission.

Short label on: the Stop TX button while it reports what it did (TX strip, and the remote browser). The same English text "Stopped" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. rtty.txline.stopped) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: The station reports the transmitter free.
italian: La stazione segnala il trasmettitore libero.

english: The station has no audio to send right now.
italian: Al momento la stazione non ha audio da inviare.

notes: Button on a station card on the Remote page that opens the live stream of Nexus at the shack. On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. The same English text "Stream" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. lanWindow.stream) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
Name read aloud by screen readers for the area that shows the live picture of Nexus at the shack.

english: Nexus at the shack. Click it, then use your mouse and keyboard to operate it. Tab leaves the picture.
italian: Nexus nello shack. Cliccaci sopra, poi usa mouse e tastiera per operarlo. Tab esce dall'immagine.
notes: Screen-reader label on the live picture itself. "Tab" is the keyboard key that moves focus out of the picture.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

On the Remote stream page (Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it): a button that makes the page fill the whole screen. The same English text "Full screen" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. map.full.enter.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

The same button, while the page fills the screen. The same English text "Exit full screen" is used by 2 different keys (e.g. map.full.exit.label) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.

english: Fill the screen with the stream, Stop TX included. Esc still stops transmitting.
italian: Riempi lo schermo con lo streaming, Stop TX incluso. Esc ferma comunque la trasmissione.
notes: Tooltip on the Full screen button. "Stop TX" is the button's own name, English on purpose (the README); "Esc" is the key.
A button over the live picture while it is zoomed in with two fingers: it shows the whole picture again.
Tooltip on the Fit button.

On the Remote stream page (Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it): a button on a phone that opens a short menu with what its bars have no room for: End the stream, Disconnect, Sign out.
A button on a phone that opens a one-line box for typing into the field selected in Nexus at the shack, with the phone's own on-screen keyboard.

english: Type here for the field selected at the shack
italian: Digita qui per il campo selezionato nello shack
notes: Placeholder text inside that one-line box, also read aloud by screen readers as its name. "The shack" is the operator's own station, where Nexus runs.

english: Turn the phone on its side for a bigger picture.
italian: Ruota il telefono in orizzontale per un'immagine più grande.
notes: Shown on a phone held upright while the stream runs: turned on its side, the picture gets the whole height of the screen.
A button the operator holds down to key the station's transmitter; letting go unkeys it.

english: Hold to talk: the rig keys when your microphone's audio arrives, and unkeys when you let go or the picture stops.
italian: Tieni premuto per parlare: la radio va in trasmissione quando arriva l'audio del microfono e torna in ricezione quando rilasci o l'immagine si ferma.
notes: Tooltip on the "Hold PTT" button.

english: Station control is off for this browser. Allow it in Nexus at the shack (Settings → Remote → Advanced), then try again.
italian: Il controllo della stazione è disattivato per questo browser. Consentilo in Nexus nello shack (Impostazioni → Remote → Avanzate), poi riprova.

english: Another browser is using this station. You can start once it lets go.
italian: Un altro browser sta usando questa stazione. Potrai iniziare quando la rilascia.

english: Ready. Start the stream to see and operate Nexus at the shack.
italian: Pronto. Avvia lo streaming per vedere e operare Nexus nello shack.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The stream is the Nexus window as Windows draws it at the shack, so Nexus there must stay open, and not minimized.
italian: Lo streaming è la finestra di Nexus come Windows la disegna nello shack, quindi Nexus lì deve restare aperto e non ridotto a icona.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. "Windows" is the operating system; "minimized" is the window sent to the taskbar.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The station couldn't start the stream just now. Start the stream again.
italian: La stazione non è riuscita ad avviare lo streaming. Avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The picture has stopped updating. The station will not transmit for this browser until it moves again.
italian: L'immagine ha smesso di aggiornarsi. La stazione non trasmetterà per questo browser finché non riprende.
notes: Shown over the live picture when it stops updating. The station refuses to transmit for a browser whose picture is out of date.

english: The station is holding off transmitting for this browser until its picture here catches up.
italian: La stazione sospende la trasmissione per questo browser finché l'immagine qui non si aggiorna.
notes: Shown over the live picture when the station says the picture this browser shows is too old for it to accept transmitting.
Button on the Remote stream page that turns this browser's microphone on, for talking on the rig. Shows the state it is in now.
The same button, while the microphone is on.

english: Your microphone, for talking on the rig. It stays off until you turn it on, and your browser asks first. Then hold PTT and talk: the rig keys when your audio arrives.
italian: Il tuo microfono, per parlare con la radio. Resta spento finché non lo attivi, e prima il browser te lo chiede. Poi tieni premuto PTT e parla: la radio va in trasmissione quando arriva il tuo audio.
notes: Tooltip on the microphone button.

Name read aloud by screen readers for the list of notes about the microphone shown over the live picture. The same English text "Microphone" is used by 3 different keys (e.g. settings.audio.pcMic.device.label, settings.phone.mic.title) — each can take a different Italian word, so choose the one that fits THIS screen.
A slider beside the microphone button: how loud the operator's voice goes to the rig.

english: How loud your voice goes to the rig, over your microphone's own level. Talk as you would on the air and raise it until your loudest words reach the end of the bar. Peaks are held 3 dB under full scale, so it never clips. This browser remembers it.
italian: Quanto forte arriva la tua voce alla radio, oltre al livello del tuo microfono. Parla come faresti in aria e alzalo finché le parole più forti raggiungono la fine della barra. I picchi sono tenuti 3 dB sotto il fondo scala, quindi non satura mai. Questo browser lo ricorda.
notes: Tooltip on the Mic level slider. "Full scale" is the loudest a digital audio signal can be.
Read aloud by screen readers for the bar beside the Mic level slider, which shows how loud the voice being sent is.

english: The rig must take its SSB audio from USB (its menu for the transmit audio source). Most radios come set to the front microphone, and then an over sends the shack's microphone instead of you.
italian: La radio deve prendere l'audio SSB da USB (il suo menu per la sorgente audio di trasmissione). La maggior parte delle radio esce impostata sul microfono frontale, e allora una trasmissione invia il microfono dello shack invece di te.
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection: the rig takes its transmit audio from the USB cable. It is not the USB sideband.

english: The microphone is blocked for this site. Allow it in the browser's settings for this site (the icon at the left of the address bar), then turn the microphone on again.
italian: Il microfono è bloccato per questo sito. Consentilo nelle impostazioni del browser per questo sito (l'icona a sinistra della barra degli indirizzi), poi riattiva il microfono.
notes: Shown when this site is blocked from the microphone in the browser. "The icon at the left of the address bar" is the browser's site-information icon (a padlock or two sliders) at the start of the web address.

english: Your computer's privacy settings are blocking the microphone for the browser. On Windows, open Settings ▸ Privacy & security ▸ Microphone and turn on microphone access, including for desktop apps. On a Mac, open System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Microphone, turn the browser on, and reopen it. Then turn the microphone on again.
italian: Le impostazioni della privacy del computer bloccano il microfono per il browser. Su Windows, apri Impostazioni ▸ Privacy e sicurezza ▸ Microfono e attiva l'accesso al microfono, anche per le app desktop. Su Mac, apri Impostazioni di Sistema ▸ Privacy e sicurezza ▸ Microfono, attiva il browser e riaprilo. Poi riattiva il microfono.
notes: Shown when the computer itself (Windows or macOS privacy settings) blocks the browser from the microphone. The menu names are Windows' and macOS's own: use the names those systems show in Italian.

english: The browser's question about the microphone was closed without an answer. Turn the microphone on again and choose Allow.
italian: La richiesta del browser sul microfono è stata chiusa senza risposta. Riattiva il microfono e scegli Consenti.
notes: "Allow" is the button in the browser's own question: use the word the browser shows in Italian.

english: No microphone was found on this computer. Plug one in, then turn the microphone on again.
italian: Nessun microfono trovato su questo computer. Collegane uno, poi riattiva il microfono.

english: The microphone was found but could not start. Another program may be using it: close that program, then turn the microphone on again.
italian: Il microfono è stato trovato ma non si è avviato. Forse un altro programma lo sta usando: chiudi quel programma, poi riattiva il microfono.

english: The browser could not get the microphone ({{name}}). Check the browser's settings for this site and the computer's microphone settings, then turn the microphone on again.
italian: Il browser non è riuscito a ottenere il microfono ({{name}}). Controlla le impostazioni del browser per questo sito e quelle del microfono del computer, poi riattiva il microfono.
notes: {{name}} is the browser's own name for the error, such as NotAllowedError, and stays in English.

english: This browser cannot send the microphone on this stream.
italian: Questo browser non può inviare il microfono in questo streaming.

english: The browser is still processing the microphone (echo cancellation, noise suppression or automatic gain), which can make your voice sound worse on the air.
italian: Il browser sta ancora elaborando il microfono (cancellazione dell'eco, soppressione del rumore o guadagno automatico), e questo può peggiorare la tua voce in aria.

english: PTT is held but your microphone is off, so nothing is transmitted. Turn the microphone on to talk.
italian: PTT è premuto ma il microfono è spento, quindi non viene trasmesso nulla. Attiva il microfono per parlare.

english: The rig shows no power out while your voice is arriving. Set its SSB audio source to USB (its menu for the transmit audio source).
italian: La radio non mostra potenza in uscita mentre arriva la tua voce. Imposta la sorgente audio SSB su USB (il suo menu per la sorgente audio di trasmissione).
notes: "USB" here is the computer connection: the rig takes its transmit audio from the USB cable. It is not the USB sideband.

english: Your connection stalled, so the transmission stopped.
italian: La tua connessione si è bloccata, quindi la trasmissione si è fermata.
notes: "Transmission" here is the radio transmission (the rig on the air).

english: Your audio stopped arriving, so the transmission stopped.
italian: Il tuo audio ha smesso di arrivare, quindi la trasmissione si è fermata.
notes: "Transmission" here is the radio transmission (the rig on the air).

english: Control was lost, so the transmission stopped.
italian: Il controllo è stato perso, quindi la trasmissione si è fermata.
notes: "Transmission" here is the radio transmission (the rig on the air).

english: The transmission ended at its 10-minute limit. Press PTT again to carry on.
italian: La trasmissione è terminata al limite di 10 minuti. Premi di nuovo PTT per continuare.

english: The TX watchdog stopped the transmission.
italian: Il watchdog TX ha fermato la trasmissione.

english: The station's audio changed, so the transmission stopped. Press PTT again.
italian: L'audio della stazione è cambiato, quindi la trasmissione si è fermata. Premi di nuovo PTT.

english: Time to give your call sign.
italian: È ora di dare il tuo nominativo.
notes: A reminder shown while the operator is transmitting: the rules require giving your call sign at least every ten minutes and at the end of a contact.

english: Remember to give your call sign at the end of the contact.
italian: Ricordati di dare il nominativo alla fine del collegamento.

english: Still there? The stream ends in a minute unless you click.
italian: Ci sei ancora? Lo streaming termina tra un minuto se non clicchi.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. Shown after fifteen minutes with no click, key press or PTT from this browser.

On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. The one button on the "Still there?" prompt.

english: Nobody answered “Still there?”, so the stream ended.
italian: Nessuno ha risposto a «Ci sei ancora?», quindi lo streaming è terminato.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air. Use the same words for "Still there?" as in remote.stream.idle.prompt.

english: The stream ended because station control was lost.
italian: Lo streaming è terminato perché il controllo della stazione è stato perso.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: This station can't stream yet. Update Nexus at the shack and turn streaming on there.
italian: Questa stazione non può ancora fare streaming. Aggiorna Nexus nello shack e attiva lì lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Your Remote access has ended, so the stream can't start.
italian: Il tuo accesso Remote è terminato, quindi lo streaming non può partire.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Remote access was switched off for this account, so the stream ended.
italian: L'accesso Remote è stato disattivato per questo account, quindi lo streaming è terminato.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then start the stream again.
italian: Troppi tentativi. Attendi un minuto, poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Your Remote access over the internet has ended, so the stream works only on the shack's own network. Connect this device to the same network as the station, then start the stream again.
italian: Il tuo accesso Remote via internet è terminato, quindi lo streaming funziona solo sulla rete dello shack. Collega questo dispositivo alla stessa rete della stazione, poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Streaming on the shack's own network needs a newer Nexus at the shack. Update Nexus there, then start the stream again.
italian: Lo streaming sulla rete dello shack richiede un Nexus più recente nello shack. Aggiorna Nexus lì, poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

italian: La stazione ha terminato lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The station's reply was not encrypted end to end, so the stream was refused.
italian: La risposta della stazione non era cifrata end-to-end, quindi lo streaming è stato rifiutato.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: This browser can't show the stream. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
italian: Questo browser non può mostrare lo streaming. Usa una versione aggiornata di Chrome, Edge, Firefox o Safari.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The stream stops while this tab is in the background. Start it again when you're back.
italian: Lo streaming si ferma mentre questa scheda è in background. Riavvialo quando torni.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The connection to the station was lost. Start the stream again.
italian: La connessione alla stazione si è interrotta. Avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Streaming is off at the shack. In Nexus there, turn on “Stream this station from my browser” (Settings → Remote), then start the stream again.
italian: Lo streaming è disattivato nello shack. In Nexus lì, attiva «Mostra questa stazione in streaming nel mio browser» (Impostazioni → Remote), poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: Quotes another control by name: "Stream this station from my browser" is the on-screen text of settings.remoteStream.label. Translate the quote and that control exactly the same way, or the hint names a control the screen does not show.

english: Another browser is streaming this station. You can stream once it ends.
italian: Un altro browser sta facendo lo streaming di questa stazione. Potrai farlo quando avrà finito.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: The station could not use this browser's stream request. Use a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
italian: La stazione non ha potuto usare la richiesta di streaming di questo browser. Usa una versione aggiornata di Chrome, Edge, Firefox o Safari.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission — pick a word that cannot be read as transmitting on the air.

english: Nexus at the shack is asking you to approve this browser. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
italian: Nexus nello shack ti chiede di approvare questo browser. Approvalo lì se mostra la chiave di questo browser, qui sotto, poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission. Shown when this browser was approved before streams checked its key.

english: This browser’s key has changed, so Nexus at the shack asks you to approve it again. Approve it there if it shows this browser’s key, below, then start the stream again.
italian: La chiave di questo browser è cambiata, quindi Nexus nello shack ti chiede di approvarlo di nuovo. Approvalo lì se mostra la chiave di questo browser, qui sotto, poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.
notes: On the Remote stream page: Nexus at the shack shown live as a picture in a web browser, and operated from it. "Stream" here means that live picture, never a radio transmission. Shown when the key this browser signs with is not the one Nexus at the shack approved.

english: This reply was not signed with your station's key, so it may not have come from your station. Nothing was connected.
italian: Questa risposta non era firmata con la chiave della tua stazione, quindi potrebbe non venire dalla tua stazione. Non è stato connesso nulla.

english: Nexus at the shack did not sign its reply, so this browser can't tell it came from your station. Update Nexus at the shack, then start the stream again.
italian: Nexus nello shack non ha firmato la sua risposta, quindi questo browser non può sapere se viene dalla tua stazione. Aggiorna Nexus nello shack, poi avvia di nuovo lo streaming.

english: This station’s key has changed, so nothing was connected. Return to your stations to compare the new key with “This station’s key” in Nexus at the shack.
italian: La chiave di questa stazione è cambiata, quindi non è stato connesso nulla. Torna alle tue stazioni per confrontare la nuova chiave con «Chiave di questa stazione» in Nexus nello shack.
notes: “This station’s key” is the start of the line where Nexus at the shack shows its key (remote.thisStationKey): use the same words, so the operator can find it there.

english: The station isn't online. Check that Nexus is running at the shack with Remote turned on, and that the computer is awake.
italian: La stazione non è online. Verifica che Nexus sia in esecuzione nello shack con Remote attivo e che il computer sia acceso.
notes: On the Remote stream page, when the station has not answered for several seconds: Nexus at the shack is closed, Remote is off there, or the computer is asleep.
